limitations.quote: // The final 0 can also start the next match.
limitations.note: The patch fixed the one-cycle match delay but also changed the transitions out of the match state so the final zero can start an overlapping match, which the correct fix does not do.
The sliding-window oracle expected overlapping matches, so the exhaustive test confirmed the agent's assumption rather than checking that the original post-match behavior was preserved.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the entire simulation invocation to be rejected, so no test ran and the agent had to resubmit it.
